pairs_touching.what_says_this: Direct, explicit, bidirectional cross-reference: S1399 states BA-ED2 is 'authorized by GN-42 Decision 1' and BA-ED2-08 quotes verbatim 'the GN-42 master constraint that Edition 2 may explain the architecture more deeply but must never expand it.' S1281 (gn42 family) states the same rule from the other side ('endorses the GN-42 rule that Edition-2 book production may explain... but may not expand it'). BA-ED2's 14 concrete production rules are the operational elaboration of GN-42's single governing principle.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If BA-ED2's rules had been independently authored before GN-42 existed (i.e., GN-42 codified pre-existing BA-ED2 practice rather than authorizing it), the direction would reverse but the relationship type would likely remain EXTENSION/REFINEMENT of the same idea.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Origin: GN-60 audit of II.3 — the nine-control pass verified evidence-map rows existed but not that cited files contained the claims (mechanical presence checking ≠ semantic evidence checking); two silent upgrades survived until an independent audit traced claims to records.
rationale_evidence.statement: States BA-ED2-14's own governance origin: it was created because the GN-60 audit of chapter II.3 found that an existing nine-control verification pass checked only that evidence-map citation rows existed, not that the cited files actually contained the claimed evidence -- exactly the same producer-control gap this batch's audit-three-lens.md (S1398) for II.3 independently reports and proposes a rule for.

rationale_evidence.anchor: BA-ED2-14 was applied forward only; the GREEN-protected zones of earlier audits ... were never swept under it. P2G-F-1/2/5/6/7 are exactly what such a retro-sweep would have caught.
rationale_evidence.statement: P2G-A-9 method observation: because the newly-adopted BA-ED2-14 citation-content control was applied only forward from its adoption date, material in earlier chapters that had already been marked GREEN-protected by prior audits was never re-swept under it -- five of the ten RED findings in this very report (P2G-F-1/2/5/6/7) are exactly what such a retroactive sweep would have caught; proposes a candidate bounded retro-sweep control, decision reserved to the HPA.
